title: TopFollower
description: JSON Schema for Sorsa common.TopFollower extracted from the OpenAPI v3 spec.

created_at.description: Account creation date in ISO 8601 format.

followers_count.description: Number of accounts following this user.

followings_count.description: Number of accounts this user follows.

profile_background_image_url.description: URL of the user's profile background image.

profile_image_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

protected.description: Whether the account's tweets are protected (private).

score.description: Whether the account accepts direct messages.

tweets_count.description: Total number of tweets posted by this user.

verified.description: Whether the account has a verified badge.
